mechanics.claim: Quinn's basic attacks and damaging abilities (Blinding Assault, Vault) automatically activate Skystrike while Behind Enemy Lines is active.
mechanics.quote: Declaring a {{tip|basic attack}} or casting ''{{ai|Blinding Assault|Quinn}}'' or ''{{ai|Vault|Quinn}}'' during ''{{ai|Behind Enemy Lines|Quinn}}'' automatically activates ''Skystrike''.

mechanics.claim: Skystrike ends Behind Enemy Lines' movement speed and ghost effects when it triggers.
mechanics.quote: '''Quinn''' detaches from '''Valor''', ending ''{{ais|Behind Enemy Lines|Quinn}}'' effects and raining arrows down around her

mechanics.claim: Upon respawning or recalling, Quinn's first Skystrike deals double damage if activated by an ability (a bug).
mechanics.quote: Upon respawning or recalling, '''Quinn's''' first ''Skytrike'' will deal double the normal amount of damage to enemies hit if activated by an ability.

mechanics.claim: Taking damage from non-minions suppresses the bonus movement speed for 3 seconds via a slow-type status effect, but does not end Behind Enemy Lines.
mechanics.quote: Taking damage from non-{{tip|minions}} removes the bonus movement speed buff temporarily by suppressing it with the status effect of a {{tip|slow}}.

mechanics.claim: Becoming immobilized, grounded, or silenced ends Behind Enemy Lines immediately and puts it on cooldown without casting Skystrike.
mechanics.quote: Becoming {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}}, {{tip|ground|grounded}}, or {{tip|silence|silenced}} ends ''Behind Enemy Lines'' immediately and puts it on {{sti|cooldown}} without performing ''{{ai|Skystrike|Quinn}}''.

mechanics.claim: Behind Enemy Lines does not refund its mana cost if canceled via recast, except to top Quinn back up to the cost if her mana fell below it.
mechanics.quote: ''Behind Enemy Lines'' does not refund its {{sti|{{as|mana cost}}}} if the channel was canceled via recast.

mechanics.claim: The ability's cooldown starts after the effect completes, not on cast.
Skystrike deals area-of-effect physical damage and can be blocked by spell shields.
